sources.title_zh: AI編程代理在獨立測試中表現優異，但在模擬職場中完成的任務卻不到十分之一
sources.title_en: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
sources.title_original: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
sources.summary: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers. The article AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一項全新的現實世界測試將AI編程代理置於模擬的開發者職位中，身邊有同事、專案看板和不完整的交接內容，它們必須在混亂的日常工作流程中自行持續開發軟體，並可靠地關閉未解決的工單。甚至連 Opus 5.5 和 Astra 也遠遠不及格，完全解決的任務不到十分之一。這些模型能快速完成清晰、獨立的任務，但作為自主開發者時卻會迷失方向。

sources.title_original: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
sources.summary: Perplexity is launching a Monitor API that searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents via webhook only when relevant changes occur. Its own decision model filters out unimportant results. For Perplexity, the API is part of a broader strategy to stand out from an increasingly interchangeable chatbot business through developer tools. The article Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Perplexity 正在推出一項監視 API，能按排程搜尋網路，並僅在發生相關變更時透過 webhook 警示代理程式。其自身的決策模型會過濾掉不重要的結果。對 Perplexity 而言，此 API 是一項更廣泛策略的一部分，旨在透過開發人員工具在日益同質化的聊天機器人業務中脫穎而出。

sources.summary: METR reports that leading AI models like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra are improving rapidly at research tasks but getting harder to measure. Current data can't rule out a dangerous acceleration in AI development, the organization warns, though it also says common tests may overestimate what the models can actually do. sources.summary: Security researchers at Dragos used two million fake AI requests to uncover serious vulnerabilities in the AI supply chain, finding at least three compromised providers, hundreds of stolen AWS keys, and marketplace resellers who were simply reading customer requests. sources.title_original: A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels
sources.summary: TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more. The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 來自哥倫比亞大學與 CertiK 的 TensorLean，使用 Lean 在 PTX 層級對正式環境的 GPU 核心進行形式化驗證。它檢查了 149 個核心例項，證明瞭 83 個正確，並在 FlashAttention、DeepGEMM 等專案中發現了 38 個錯誤。

sources.title_original: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
sources.summary: Perplexity is launching a Monitor API that searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents via webhook only when relevant changes occur. Its own decision model filters out unimportant results. For Perplexity, the API is part of a broader strategy to stand out from an increasingly interchangeable chatbot business through developer tools. The article Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Perplexity 正在推出一項監視 API，能按排程搜尋網路，並僅在發生相關變更時透過 webhook 警示代理程式。其自身的決策模型會過濾掉不重要的結果。對 Perplexity 而言，此 API 是一項更廣泛策略的一部分，旨在透過開發人員工具在日益同質化的聊天機器人業務中脫穎而出。

sources.title: 資安研究人員展示廉價AI推論供應商如何竊取金鑰並窺探使用者 / Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users

sources.title_en: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users
sources.title_original: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users
sources.summary: Security researchers at Dragos used two million fake AI requests to uncover serious vulnerabilities in the AI supply chain, finding at least three compromised providers, hundreds of stolen AWS keys, and marketplace resellers who were simply reading customer requests. OpenRouter responded by removing three providers and 125 endpoints. The article Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Dragos的資安研究人員利用200萬個虛假的AI請求，揭露了AI供應鏈中的嚴重漏洞，發現至少3家遭到入侵的供應商、數百個被竊取的AWS金鑰，以及只是在讀取客戶請求的市集轉售商。OpenRouter隨後移除了3家供應商與125個端點。

sources.title: AI編程代理在獨立測試中表現優異，但在模擬職場中完成的任務卻不到十分之一 / AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
sources.title_zh: AI編程代理在獨立測試中表現優異，但在模擬職場中完成的任務卻不到十分之一
sources.title_en: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
sources.title_original: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
sources.summary: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers. The article AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一項全新的現實世界測試將AI編程代理置於模擬的開發者職位中，身邊有同事、專案看板和不完整的交接內容，它們必須在混亂的日常工作流程中自行持續開發軟體，並可靠地關閉未解決的工單。甚至連 Opus 5.5 和 Astra 也遠遠不及格，完全解決的任務不到十分之一。這些模型能快速完成清晰、獨立的任務，但作為自主開發者時卻會迷失方向。
